card: Change the pace of an HTML5 video.
title: Video Controls Plus for a video on the web
intro: Video Controls Plus puts playback controls beside HTML5 video across sites. Speed, looping and frame steps give you a closer look.

sections.heading: Which videos can it control?
sections.body: It works with HTML5 video on the web.

sections.heading: How precisely can playback change?
sections.body: Speed runs from 0.1× to 16×, with A–B loops and steps one frame at a time.

sections.heading: What can you change about the picture and sound?
sections.body: Audio boost, filters and colour correction are available too.

sections.heading: Where does Video Controls Plus fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell is a place to keep moments and notes. Video Controls Plus changes how you watch HTML5 video on another site.
